A late start and a new friend.
Yesterday was different from my usual school day. I woke up at eight because my alarm clock was set for the weekend. I got up quickly and had a biscuit while Mum made breakfast. We went to school by car, but I was still a few minutes late. At school, I could not find my diary. I thought it was in my bag, but it was on the table at home. Our teacher said I could write the homework on a spare piece of paper. During lunchtime, I saw a new pupil sitting alone. His name was Ben. The room was noisy, and he could not hear my first question. We moved to a quiet table. I asked about his old school, and he told me he enjoyed drawing. I took a small notebook from my bag and showed him my pictures. In the afternoon, we worked together on a poster. Ben drew the pictures, and I wrote the words. Our teacher put it on the wall. At home, I found my diary and wrote about Ben. The day started badly, but it ended with a new friend. Before bed, I checked my alarm clock carefully.
